title: Bobo Learns to Sleep
moral: Simple calming habits can help you rest well.

scenes.summary: Bobo the bear enjoys playing but struggles to sleep at night.
scenes.text:
Bobo the Bear Who Couldn’t Sleep

In a quiet forest under a sky full of stars, lived a little bear named Bobo.

Bobo loved to play all day.

He climbed trees, chased butterflies, and rolled in the grass.

But when night came…

Bobo had a problem.

He couldn’t sleep.
scenes.image_prompt: cute bear playing in forest during day then looking awake at night under stars, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Bobo tries to sleep but is disturbed by nighttime sounds and stays awake.
scenes.text:
Every night, Bobo lay in his cozy bed.

He closed his eyes.

He turned left.

He turned right.

“I’m not sleepy,” he said.

He listened to the sounds outside.

Hoot… hoot…

Crickets chirped.

Leaves rustled.

Everything felt too noisy.
scenes.image_prompt: bear tossing and turning in bed hearing owl and crickets, night forest cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bobo feels tired during the day and seeks help from friends.
scenes.text:
The next morning, Bobo felt very tired.

He yawned.

He moved slowly.

“I don’t feel like playing,” he said.

His friend Lulu the Fox noticed.

“You look sleepy,” she said.

“I can’t sleep at night,” Bobo sighed.

Lulu smiled.

“Let’s ask Omi the Owl,” she said.

“Omi knows everything about the night.”

They found Omi sitting on a tree branch.

“I can’t sleep,” Bobo said.

Omi nodded.

“Let me help you,” he said.
scenes.image_prompt: tired bear talking to fox and wise owl in forest, friendly cartoon style

scenes.summary: Omi teaches Bobo calming techniques to help him sleep.
scenes.text:
That evening, Omi gave Bobo a plan.

“Before bed,” he said,

“take deep breaths.”

“Listen to soft sounds.”

“And think of something peaceful.”

Bobo tried it.

He lay down quietly.

He took a deep breath.

In… out…

Bobo listened to the gentle sounds of the forest.

The wind felt soft.

The night felt calm.

He imagined floating on a fluffy cloud.

Slowly…

His eyes closed.
scenes.image_prompt: bear peacefully lying in bed breathing calmly imagining clouds, soothing night cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bobo sleeps well and wakes up happy and energetic.
scenes.text:
For the first time, Bobo fell asleep easily.

He slept through the whole night.

The next morning, he woke up happy and full of energy.

“I slept so well!” he said.

A calm mind helps you rest well.

Simple habits can make a big difference.

The End
scenes.image_prompt: happy bear waking up refreshed in morning sunlight, cheerful forest cartoon style
